summary: Fail doctor for a current missing-agent mission fault lasting five minutes

replay.detail: Reuses current fault projection and an indexed exact-episode lookup. No replay trigger, new fault claim or history fold.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or public resource field changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint-rule, declaration authority, currentness predicate or timer changes.

compatibility.detail: Doctor adds check mission-no-eligible-agent, failing for existing current episodes at least five minutes old. Before the threshold the check passes; source recovery clears it. Requires the stable fault condition introduced by PR1850; no second attention episode is created.

downtime.detail: Uses the ordinary daemon upgrade. Upgrade interruption is not measured by this source control.

manual.detail: No new operator step; declare a seat or revise the existing assignment through normal controls.

recovery.detail: Rollback removes the bounded doctor failure while existing canonical fault history remains readable. The earlier immediate current fault attention behavior remains available on builds containing PR1850.
